fact: The chapter says the Digital Transformation of the Education Ministry (MOETE) connects governorates, districts and schools by digitalising administrative processes and collecting, storing and organising individual-level data about students, teachers and assets.
The chapter says the Digital Identity Project records and stores data on students (attainment, attendance, tablet use, health) in central secured databases.
